anomalies.observed: The VMOT voltage-sense divider uses R25 = 50K 0.1% from VMOT to NET0120 and R34 = 5.1K 0.1% from NET0120 to GND. NET0120 feeds U49 pin 4 (ADS1115 AIN0), and U49 is powered from +3V3.
anomalies.expected: With VMOT protected by a 51V TVS and using 63V bulk capacitors, the divider must keep the ADS1115 input below its 3.3V supply over the full VMOT range. R34 = 5.1K gives about 3.7V at 41.4V and 4.4V at 48V; the lower resistor should be about 3.3K or less, or the divider ratio changed accordingly.

evidence.quote: Motion Sensing sheet: R25 50K 0.1% from VMOT to NET0120; R34 5.1K 0.1% from NET0120 to GND; U49 ADS1115 AIN0 on NET0120; U49 VDD +3V3.
Power sheet: D16 SMAJ51A on VMOT; C5/C76 47uF 63V solid on VMOT.
Supercap auxiliary board uses eighteen 120F 2.3V supercapacitor cells, consistent with a roughly 41V-class main bus.

anomalies.impact: The input-voltage ADC will saturate or be overvolted at high VMOT, so VMOT sensing will be incorrect and the ADS1115 input may be damaged.

parsed.summary: The VMOT-sense divider feeding the 3.3V ADS1115 is scaled too high: 50K/5.1K can drive the ADC input above its supply on the high-voltage motor bus, so the voltage measurement is not valid over the intended range.
